overview.description: The Corgi U.S. Biotech 2x Daily ETF (XBIX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in health care equity. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of the SPDR S&P Biotech ETF (Ticker: XBI), which provides exposure to US biotechnology stocks. XBIX was launched on Jun 3, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
